name: Partner User-Provisioning System -- templated provisioning scripts -> internal UI -> partner-admin self-service
description: Andrew-direct 2026-06-29: ad-hoc user creation (hand-running create_user_v2.py, e.g. the 5 ADVI_COTUSR/INFUSR users) won't scale as Portal/Advisor-Intelligence activity grows. END-STATE: partner-firm ADMINS self-serve -- an admin page where a firm's admin adds their own users + scopes permissions, instead of us doing it. 3-PHASE system, LEADING with the templating of the provisioning scripts: P1 templated provisioning (productionize create_user_v2.py into a clean declarative-config, idempotent, AUDITED library + collapse the 3-copy firm-scope drift -- FIRM#META.domain + firmAccess.ts + the script FIRMS dict -- into ONE source of truth, the cottonwood-domain-drift class); P2 internal provisioning UI (an Opal-internal admin surface calling the P1 engine, so we stop hand-running scripts); P3 partner-admin self-service (a SCOPED admin page gated on firmRole=admin where a partner firm's admin manages ONLY their firm's users, tenant-isolated). LOAD-BEARING SECURITY (P3, PRD section 8): multi-tenant privilege surface -- the firmId MUST be server-derived from the caller's JWT, NEVER client-supplied (the cross-tenant escalation vector); firmRole=admin gates page AND API; scope-ceiling enforced server-side (no internal-tier, no admin-granting v1, no cross-firm, within the firm allowlist); every action audited; CVO ratifies tenant-isolation vs live. The 4-layer provisioning invariant (opal-users-v2 PROFILE+MEMBER / firmAccess.ts / JWT claims / opal-partner-{firm}) per docs/reference/user-provisioning-firm-scope-profiles-20260528.md.
